forms.label: Paste
forms.sourceNote: USDA has no record for ají panca. This is its record for dried ancho pepper, a comparably mild, dark, fruity dried chilli; the commercial paste is this kind of pod rehydrated and blended with a little oil, so the figures here are indicative rather than specific to the product.
forms.nutritionCaveat: Cited against dried ancho pods. Commercial ají panca paste is rehydrated with water and a little oil before jarring, which dilutes it below the concentration of the whole dried pod, so these figures likely overstate the paste's true density somewhat.
